customMethods.name: openEditor
customMethods.script:
changeIds = [item['changeId'] for item in self.view.custom.table.selectedData]
	system.perspective.print('changeIds %s'%changeIds)
	system.perspective.openPopup('changeEditor', 'kanoa/core/devOps/changeEditor', {'values':{'changeIds': changeIds}}, resizeable=True, draggable=True, showCloseIcon=True)
	
	return

customMethods.name: deleteChanges
customMethods.script:
userId = system.kanoa.security.getIDPUserId(self.session.props.auth.user)
	changeIds = [row['changeId'] for row in self.view.custom.table.selectedData]
	system.kanoa.devOps.deleteAppChange(changeIds, userId)
	self.view.custom.table.row = None
	
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.table.data")
	
	return
